body:
Examples:

Coverage available
+ low adoption
+ high price

→ evaluate affordability + outreach + digital-literacy interventions.

No wired broadband
+ line-of-sight tower opportunity

→ evaluate fixed wireless.

Low-income students
+ limited device access
+ adequate broadband

→ evaluate device bank + lending program.

Clinic access gap
+ reliable broadband
+ community building

→ evaluate telehealth hub.

Always present interventions as candidates for evaluation.

title: ZERO-HARM / ANTI-INVERSION
ATTRIBUTIONS & LICENSES
FINAL QUALITY REQUIREMENT
body:
The finished application must function as a genuine **Texas Connectivity & Opportunity Operating System**, not:

- an ISP directory;
- static broadband map;
- speed-test page;
- digital-literacy blog;
- grant-link collection.

Users should be able to:

**measure
diagnose
compare
learn
plan
map
research
record
export
coordinate
build
and act.**

The central design principle should be:

**Connectivity has value only when people can afford it, trust it, use it safely, access adequate devices, and convert it into real educational, health, economic and community opportunity.**
